payload.title: Uniform time sampling with Pyleoclim
payload.description: This notebook demonstrates methods for achieving uniform time sampling in paleoclimate data using the Pyleoclim library. It addresses the common issue of uneven time spacing in paleosciences by exploring interpolation, binning, resampling, and Gaussian kernel coarsening techniques.

steps.title: Interpolation

steps.description: Average the series values over uniform bins to achieve uniform time sampling.
steps.title: Binning

steps.description: Use the pandas resampler to aggregate data over specified time intervals.
steps.title: Resampling
